scope: NBA regular season only; no 2026 data or forecasts evaluated
source: Official NBA injury-report PDFs; require embedded report timestamp AND PDF creation timestamp before cutoff
cutoff: Earlier of tipoff minus 60 minutes and 18:00 America/New_York on game date; request report filename hour one hour before floored cutoff, then at most two earlier hours
missing: If either team is not explicitly submitted, document invalid/missing, or matchup/date not matched, use original V1 probability exactly
importance: Mean minutes and points from up to 20 earlier eligible appearances; canonical athlete identities learned only from earlier dates; no current-game participation used

variants.coverage_control: V1 logit offset plus intercept learned on earlier both-submitted report cohort
variants.status_counts: V1 logit offset plus separate Out/Doubtful/Questionable/Probable counts
variants.minutes_weighted: V1 logit offset plus separate prior-minute loads and Out prior-point load

residual_fit: Expanding earlier-season true OOF V1 predictions, restricted to both-submitted reports from 2021 onward; standardized added features fit on training only; fixed V1 logit coefficient=1, unpenalized intercept, L2 coefficient penalty=0.5*sum(beta^2), L-BFGS-B maxiter=1000; no tuning
source_quality_gate: At least 70% both-submitted eligible evaluation games in every season; all document timestamps verified; report malformed/unknown contexts never assumed healthy
selection_gate: Candidate must improve pooled Brier by >=0.0005 and log loss over V1, preserve V1 correct count, improve Brier in >=2/3 seasons and both 2024/2025, and improve pooled Brier/log loss over coverage-only control. Development shortlist only, never promotion.
reporting: Report full identical evaluation cohort, both-submitted secondary cohort, missingness, name/impact match coverage, all candidates and date-cluster descriptive bootstrap; development seasons already inspected are not fresh holdouts
preserve: No edits to V1 weights, reserved 69.19% result, prospective ledgers, public UI or other sports
